run_parse_and_cache_pairs: run the CLI to parse and cache image pairs for the habitat_release dataset
create_PairsDataset: create a PairsDataset instance from dataset names with optional transforms and normalization
load_pairs_from_cache_file: load image pairs from a cache file containing two paths per line
load_pairs_from_list_file: load image pairs from a listing file by appending _1.jpg and _2.jpg suffixes
write_cache_file: write a list of image pairs to a cache file with optional root path stripping
